author: mindmap-scout-intake-writer
readerQuestion: What should I use instead of Expensify for expense reports? [verb-only — no PAA, no completions]

presentation.medium: structured comparison table with scenario cost model
presentation.placement: Opening direct answer followed by comparison matrix and 3-scenario cost/break-even table
presentation.reason: Buyers comparing Expensify options need verifiable tier math and explicit break-even thresholds rather than generic prose.

interaction.reason: Three pre-computed team/workload scenarios answer the switching math faster without widget friction.

animation.reason: Static scannable tables communicate pricing thresholds immediately.

decisionGap: Pricing pages state per-seat rates but do not show team-size totals, the 3-user cap on Zoho Expense's free plan, or 5-user minimums at Rydoo and Sage Expense Management.
finding: Zoho Expense, Ramp, Brex, BILL Spend & Expense, Sage Expense Management and Rydoo are six Expensify alternatives, and four of them publish a software price below Expensify's $5 per member per month. Zoho Expense Standard is $4 per user billed monthly, and Ramp, Brex Essentials and BILL Spend & Expense each list $0 per user.
conditions: Published per-seat software prices only, no corporate card rewards, no travel booking fees, no implementation or add-on fees, standard self-serve plans.
whatWouldChange: A change to Expensify's $5 Collect price, Zoho Expense's $4 Standard price, or a vendor adding a per-user fee to its $0 plan would move the cost ranking.
method: Deterministic total-cost-of-ownership calculation across 3 standardized team/usage scenarios using published base fees, per-seat charges, included volume caps, overage blocks, and mandatory channel add-ons.
limitations: Excludes negotiated enterprise discounts, implementation labor, and third-party telephony/LLM API pass-through usage outside published plan allowances.
counterexample: At 3 members Expensify Collect costs $15 a month while Zoho Expense's Free plan, capped at 3 users, costs $0. At 100 members Zoho Expense Standard at $4 a user is $400 a month against Expensify's $500, a $100 monthly gap ($1,200 a year). Below 5 users the ranking flips toward Expensify: at 4 members Expensify Collect is $20 a month, while Rydoo and Sage Expense Management both state a 5-user starting point, which is $60 and $59.95 at 5 users.
caseDecisions: Evaluated retrieved _approved-cases.json candidates; relied on deterministic vendor-rate scenario modeling and Layer3 catalog context without claiming unverified client outcomes.

comparisons.reason: Multi-vendor published pricing tiers and usage caps directly govern switching TCO.
comparisons.scope: Published self-serve tiers across 8 compared vendors as of 2026-11-28.

sources.extractedFacts: Expensify (Collect): base=$0/mo, perSeat=$5/mo, includedVolume=0.0001. Best fit: small teams. Features/Notes: $5 per member per month; Submit plan free; Control custom pricing from $9 per member per month.
Zoho Expense (Standard (billed monthly)): base=$0/mo, perSeat=$4/mo, includedVolume=0.0001. Features/Notes: $4 per user per month billed monthly, $3 billed annually; Free plan capped at 3 users.
Rydoo (Essentials (billed monthly)): base=$0/mo, perSeat=$12/mo, includedVolume=0.0001. Features/Notes: $12 per user per month billed monthly, $9 billed annually; starts at 5 users.
Sage Expense Management (Growth (billed annually)): base=$0/mo, perSeat=$11.99/mo, includedVolume=0.0001. Features/Notes: $11.99 per active user per month billed annually; minimum billing 5 users.
Brex (Essentials): base=$0/mo, perSeat=$0/mo, includedVolume=0.0001. Features/Notes: $0 per user per month; Premium $12 per user per month.
Brex Premium (Premium): base=$0/mo, perSeat=$12/mo, includedVolume=0.0001. Features/Notes: $12 per user per month.
Ramp (Free): base=$0/mo, perSeat=$0/mo, includedVolume=0.0001. Features/Notes: $0 per user per month; Plus $15 per user per month plus a platform fee based on team size (not published as a number).
BILL Spend & Expense (Spend & Expense): base=$0/mo, perSeat=$0/mo, includedVolume=0.0001. Features/Notes: $0 per user per month with no subscription or per-user software fee.
